description.text:
The Variety Treasure Box (收藏周边礼盒 百变宝盒) came out on 15 November 2024 with Victory Star Guide. Each box held one random Pokémon holo, one of 30, with a mini damage-counter box showing that Pokémon; one random Energy or Trainer holo, one of 38 made in equal numbers; one random 25-card pack of Primordial Arts, Nine Colours Gathering, Brave Stars or Shadow of the Blue Sea; and one random enhanced pack of Scorching Skies, Final Flame Dance, Shadow of Glory or Victory Star Guide.

Of the 30 Pokémon, 20 are regular holos. Five Pokémon V, Entei V, Suicune V, Lumineon V, Drapion V and Raikou V, are hidden cards, and five more, Ditto, Arceus VSTAR, Kricketune, Lugia VSTAR and Hisuian Zoroark VSTAR, are super-hidden cards, each with its own mini box. The other 38 cards are 28 Trainers and 10 Energy. The back of the box first listed 8 basic Energy and 30 Trainers; Pokémon China corrected this on 30 October 2024, before the box went on sale. Its cards are numbered out of 66; the super-hidden Kricketune and Ditto are numbered past it, 067 and 068.
